sql: SELECT standard AS otp_standard, SUM(ontime_pickups) AS ontime_pickups, SUM(total_pickups) AS total_pickups, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ontime_pickups) / NULLIF(SUM(total_pickups), 0), 1) AS otp_pct FROM pickup_otp_daily WHERE service_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND service_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY standard ORDER BY standard
notes: Assumes 2025 means calendar year by service_date, OTP = on-time pickups divided by total pickups across Primary and Broker, reported separately per standard because each trip is counted once per standard and the 20-minute standard only exists from late 2021.

sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT SUM(complaints) AS n
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND opened_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND provider_type <> 'Non-Transportation'
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(trips) AS n
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE service_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND service_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT
  c.n AS complaints_2024,
  t.n AS trips_2024,
  ROUND(1000.0 * c.n / t.n, 1) AS complaints_per_1000_trips
FROM c, t;
notes: Assumes calendar year 2024, complaints counted by opened_date and trips by service_date, Non-Transportation complaints excluded because they have no matching trip base, and all other provider types pooled since the two tables' provider categories only partly overlap.

sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(no_shows_per_1000), 1) AS avg_no_shows_per_1000_primary_2023 FROM provider_no_shows_monthly WHERE provider_type = 'Primary' AND month >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND month < DATE '2024-01-01'
notes: Assumes the answer is the simple average of the 12 monthly Primary no-show rates for 2023 (per 1,000 scheduled trips), since the table has no trip counts to weight by.
